clips.about: Each kit thing that moves: its clips as its kind wrote them (what it is and how a player meets it, whether it plays at the start, whether it loops, its seconds). A clip of tracks is the glb's animation named in its `animation`, moving the bones of the kit mesh's skin. A clip of poses moves the parts it names: each pose a time and its morph target on the glb's kit mesh, null where the pose is the thing as it stands, each corner going in a straight line between two poses. Each joint is a bone a game may pose with no clip: `joint` its node among the skin's joints, `axis` in that node's own space, `range` the degrees from rest it may turn, and `couple` (where it has one) the joint whose turn drives it, `ratio` times over, as the thing's own linkage does.

fire.about: One shot with rounds left in the magazine: trigger, hammer, op rod, carrier and bolt, the case thrown, the next round fed, the port's cover knocked open.
fire.how: Each shot; the game then plays the magazine's count.

fire_last.about: The shot that empties the magazine: the carrier caught back on the bolt catch.

reload.about: The magazine dropped free and a full one seated, a round still chambered.

reload_empty.about: The empty magazine dropped, a full one seated, the bolt catch slapped and the carrier run home chambering a round.

inspect.about: A press check: the charging handle drawn back to see the brass, let home, the forward assist pressed.

draw.about: The selector swept from safe to semi.

holster.about: The selector thumbed back to safe.

bolt_open.about: The charging handle drawn, the chambered round pulled out and thrown from the port, and the bolt caught open.

bolt_close.about: The bolt catch slapped, the carrier home.

stock_collapse.about: Its lever pressed and the stock slid home along the buffer tube, 101.6 mm, to the castle nut.

stock_extend.about: Its lever pressed and the stock drawn out to its last stop.

fire.about: Struck back by the piston as the gas comes off the barrel, knocking the carrier back by its key, and returned by its spring.

fire_last.how: The shot that empties the magazine.

fire.about: Knocked open by the carrier on the first shot, down against the receiver; it stays open.

fire_last.how: The shot that empties the magazine.

reload_empty.about: Open, as the last shot left it.

inspect.about: Knocked open as the carrier is drawn back.

bolt_open.about: Knocked open as the carrier is drawn back.

dust_cover_close.about: Swung up and snapped shut over the port by a finger.

draw.about: Swept from safe to semi by the thumb as the gun comes up.

sights_fold.about: The rear sight's leaf pressed down flat along its base.
sights_fold.how: Folding the irons away under an optic.

sights_raise.about: The rear sight's leaf flipped up and locked standing.

sights_fold.about: The front sight's leaf pressed down flat along its base.
sights_fold.how: Folding the irons away under an optic.

sights_raise.about: The front sight's leaf flipped up and locked standing.

fire.about: The top round stripped forward out of the lips and up into the chamber by the bolt running home; the next one up takes its place.
fire.how: Each shot that leaves a round to feed.

reload.about: Let go by the release and fallen free of the well; a full one pushed up into the well and tugged to be sure the catch holds.

reload_empty.about: The empty one fallen free; a full one seated.

shot.about: Fired: the bullet gone down the bore, the case drawn back with the breech and thrown from the port tumbling, then the next round chambered in its place.
shot.how: Each shot: its gun plays fire on every piece.

shot_last.about: Fired, the last round: the bullet gone, the case thrown, nothing chambered after it.
shot_last.how: The shot that empties the gun.

fire.about: The op rod drives the carrier back its full travel, its cam pin turning the bolt to unlock and drawing the case; the buffer spring runs it home, stripping the next round, the bolt turned home to lock.
fire.how: Each shot: the game plays fire on every piece.

fire_last.about: The last shot: back, and caught on the raised bolt catch, held open, the bolt unlocked.
fire_last.how: The shot that empties the magazine.

reload_empty.about: Held back on the catch while the magazine is changed, run home when it is slapped, the bolt locking.

inspect.about: Drawn back 25 mm by the charging handle for a press check (the bolt unlocked), let home, pressed home by the forward assist.

bolt_open.about: Drawn back its travel by the charging handle and let forward onto the bolt catch.

bolt_close.about: Let home by the catch, slapped, the bolt locking.

inspect.about: Drawn back 25 mm by its latch for a press check, and pushed home.

bolt_open.about: Its latch pressed out and the handle drawn back its full travel, taking the carrier with it, and pushed home alone.

inspect.about: Pressed with the heel of the hand to be sure the bolt is home, and let out.

fire_last.about: Lifted by the empty magazine's follower in front of the bolt as the carrier comes back, holding it open.
fire_last.how: The shot that empties the magazine.

reload_empty.about: Held up through the change, slapped down by the palm to let the carrier home.

bolt_open.about: Pressed up by a finger while the charging handle holds the carrier back.

reload.about: The magazine release pressed in by the trigger finger to let the magazine fall, and let out; its catch bar and the paddle on the left go with it.

reload_empty.about: Pressed to drop the empty magazine, and let out.

fire.about: The trigger pressed back about its pin, its nose letting the hammer go, and let forward to reset; the disconnector on its pin rides with it.

fire_last.about: Pressed and let go, the last shot.
fire_last.how: The shot that empties the magazine.

fire.about: Let go by the trigger, falling forward on the firing pin; ridden down past cocked by the carrier going back and caught cocked as it comes home.

fire_last.about: Falls, and is held down under the carrier caught back.

reload_empty.about: Held down under the carrier until it runs home.

inspect.about: Ridden down a little by the carrier drawn back 25 mm, and up again.

bolt_open.about: Ridden down by the carrier drawn back, and held there.

bolt_close.about: Caught cocked as the carrier runs home.

guns.about: The G95A1 as a gun a game fires (core's guns3d, through item3d's sidecar): its words for each stage it brings, its points and where a hand takes each part in each clip. Every point is in the kit's frame (x the gun's right, y toward the muzzle, z up, metres, the gun's zero as g95.py's header says), on the bone whose name ends with `bone` when a part carries it, else on the gun itself; `turn` is degrees about the item's own x, y and z (y up, the muzzle toward -z) of the hand that takes it. Each clip of `hands` gives each hand that moves in it a list of [seconds, point]: the hand on that point at that moment, moving straight from each to the next; `rest` is where each hand is when no clip of `hands` plays. `left hand` and `right hand` are the empties a body's hands reach for, which guns3d moves along `hands` every frame; they stand where `rest` puts them as the gun is made.

sources.rpm: H&K's published cyclic rate for the HK416 A8 family, 850 rounds a minute
sources.speed: the US Army's published muzzle velocity of M855 from a 14.5 in barrel, 905 m/s; the G95A1's 16.5 in is not published
sources.range: H&K's published effective range of the HK416 A8, 600 m
